capabilities: Schedule review dates in note frontmatter via an interactive modal or batch selection
Sync due SRS notes to InnerLevel as grouped or individual action cards
Capture selected text or the current note as a quick InnerLevel card
Auto-sync due notes once daily on Obsidian startup
Self-heal syncs by re-creating cards deleted in InnerLevel
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool for keeping files across devices in sync; it pushes study-note metadata to the InnerLevel app.
extras: Sends card titles, excerpts, and obsidian:// deep links to a user-configured Supabase backend on sync; supports English and Spanish frontmatter keys and interface; installable via BRAT; includes network and vault-access disclosures.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push due study notes and captures into an external gamified task app, so reviewing stays disconnected from the user's productivity workflow.

relations.evidence: Detects notes using properties from popular community plugins like Spaced Repetition (cards-deck, deck)
Dataview fields (category, topic, subject), or simply your vault's folder organization
integrates your Obsidian vault notes and Spaced Repetition System (SRS) with the InnerLevel gamified productivity app
Install and enable InnerLevel Sync in Obsidian Settings (via Community Plugins or BRAT)

requires.name: Supabase URL and anon key for the InnerLevel project
Spaced Repetition or Dataview metadata (optional; falls back to folder names)

summary: Syncs Obsidian SRS due notes and quick captures into gamified action cards in the InnerLevel productivity app via Supabase.
